title: Practice: the governance files of a claims assistant (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 no control that guards an input or an action fails open
cases.says: No control that guards an input or an action fails open

cases.id: e1 every high consequence action has a human step that exists and holds
cases.says: Every high-consequence action has a human step that exists, is high tier and holds

cases.id: e2 the automatic threshold is at least 95 and a high consequence action is never automatic
cases.says: The automatic threshold is at least 95 (exactly 95 is allowed), a high-consequence action is never automatic and an unsupported answer is held

cases.id: e3 retention keeps at least 90 days within the ceiling and stores no content
cases.says: The audit floor is at least 90 days, the days kept lie within the ceiling, no content is stored and a legal hold wins

cases.id: e4 the risk register names a control and an owner for each of four failure modes
cases.says: The register has four rows with a defined control, a named owner and the four failure modes

cases.id: e5 users are told that ai helped and no file holds personal data
cases.says: The register says users are told that AI helped, and no file holds a personal path or address

cases.id: e6 erasure removes the vault mapping within 30 days
cases.says: Erasure removes the vault mapping and completes within 30 days (exactly 30 is allowed)
